description: A simple Minecraft mod that (mostly) fixes the MC-127862 bug, which sometimes makes the Alt Gr key lock your left control key. It prevents the bug from happening in text fields in most situations.

mods.name: Fix Alt Gr
mods.description: A simple Minecraft mod that (mostly) fixes the MC-127862 bug, which sometimes makes pressing the Alt Gr key lock your left control key in a pressed state.
